text.p: Pakistan batsman Aamir Sohail was reported for dissent during his side's limited overs World Series defeat by Australia on Thursday.
The opener was clearly unhappy about the nature of his dismissal for six.
"Sohail was reported to match referee Ramam Subba Row but there will be no announcement about the outcome of the hearing until Friday," said Australian Cricket Board spokesman Patrick Keane.

The left-hander appeared to gesticulate towards umpires Darryl Hair and Peter Parker, suggesting that the delivery that claimed his wicket should have been called a no-ball because it bounced above shoulder height.
Sohail hooked the short-pitch ball from fast bowler Anthony Stuart to Darren Lehmann at fine leg.
